## Statutory Compliance Frameworks Handled
- **Companies Act, 2013**: Sections 139, 143, 141 (Statutory Audit, CARO 2020, Internal Financial Controls).
- **Income Tax Act, 1961**: Sections 44AB (Tax Audit), 115BAA (22% Concessional Corporate Tax), 54/54EC (Capital Gains Relief), 143(2)/148 (Scrutiny Assessments).
- **Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017**: Sections 22/24 (Registration), 16(2)(aa) & Rule 36(4) (Input Tax Credit), 61 & Rule 99 (Form ASMT-10/11), GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C reconciliation.
- **RERA Act, 2016**: Section 4(2)(l)(D) (70% Escrow Account Withdrawals, CA Form 3 Certification).
- **Banking Norms**: RBI guidelines on Working Capital Assessment, Tandon/Nayak Committee recommendations, CMA data packaging.
